highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves browser WebGPU packaging, Android texture rendering, and managed graphics and text-shaping performance.
highlights_body: Browser WebGPU apps can link against the packaged native archive without compiling C++ support themselves. Android texture rendering now follows display refresh, while image copying and HarfBuzz text shaping avoid unnecessary managed and native allocations.

bullets.lead: Browser WebGPU support is packaged with the native archive
bullets.detail: The emdawnwebgpu implementation is included in libSkiaSharp.a, so browser applications can link WebGPU support without separately compiling its C++ source.

bullets.lead: Android texture rendering follows the display clock
bullets.detail: Continuous Android GL texture rendering is paced by display refresh rather than buffer-swap throughput, reducing unnecessary paint callbacks while preserving explicit render requests and lifecycle behavior.

bullets.lead: Front-buffered managed streams no longer retain data unnecessarily
bullets.detail: Corrects stream retention so front-buffered managed streams can release data when it is no longer needed.

bullets.lead: Image copying and text shaping reduce temporary allocations
bullets.detail: Managed pixel buffers that can be copied directly avoid an intermediate SKData instance, while HarfBuzz UTF-32 input and feature-string formatting reuse storage without changing existing decoding behavior.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Packaged the emdawnwebgpu implementation for browser WebGPU applications
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Stabilized browser sample testing by waiting for the first CPU canvas paint
